usedFor: Callyzer tracks your calls, and HubSpot receives a deal through “Create Deal” when “New Event” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in Callyzer, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A call event opens a deal in HubSpot, so conversations that matter start in your pipeline.

watchOut: “New Event” in Callyzer fires for any event, so “Create Deal” can open deals for calls that need none.
